claim: The official Nara tourism site lists Yatadera's hydrangea viewing period as early June to early July, over 10,000 shrubs, admission 700 yen adults / 300 yen children, located at 3549 Yatacho, Yamato-Koriyama, with extra buses from Kintetsu Koriyama station in June-July.
quote: over 10,000 hydrangea shrubs around Yatadera Temple ... Adults: 700 yen ... 3549 Yatacho, Yamato Koriyama ... Extra buses run from Kintetsu Koriyama station in June and July

claim: neoNARA confirms Yatadera holds roughly 10,000 hydrangeas in 60 varieties (peak May 25-June 30, 8:30-17:00, 700 yen, bus from Kintetsu-Koriyama to the Yatadera stop) and names other Nara hydrangea temples: Hasedera (3,000+, mid-June to mid-July), Okadera (~3,000), Hannyaji, and free Umami/Umakami parks (4,000).
quote: Approximately 10,000 hydrangeas in 60 varieties ... Peak viewing: May 25 – June 30 ... Hasedera Temple ... Over 3,000 hydrangeas ... Okadera Temple ... Approximately 3,000 ... Umakami Kyuryo Park: 4,000 hydrangeas; free admission

claim: A Nara local guide corroborates Yatadera as the premier June hydrangea spot (10,000 plants, 60 species, 700 yen) and lists other rainy-season draws: Umami Hillside Park irises as 'the key feature of June', fireflies near Nigatsu-do (8-9 p.m.), and a Rose Festival at Ofusa Kannon (May 15-June 30).
quote: an amazing 10,000 blooming plants of 60 different species ... Umami Hillside Park ... features irises as "the key feature of June" ... Fireflies ... around Nara Park near Nigatsu-do Temple ... Rose Festival: May 15–June 30 at Ofusa Kannon Temple

claim: Takidani Hanashobu Garden in Uda, Nara Prefecture is a dedicated iris (hanashobu) garden in a valley about 10 minutes' walk from Kintetsu Osaka Line's Sambonmatsu Station, with irises flowering in June.
quote: Takidani Hanashobu Garden ... Uda, Nara Prefecture ... about 10 minutes walk from Kintetsu Osaka Line station Sambomatsu ... irises ... flower in June
